audit.why: Ranged burst laner with a reload pattern. He owns levels 1-2 on double-shot autos; Aatrox flips it at 3 once he can chain and stick.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Collateral Damage (R) is 100/80/60 and the shell explodes into a cone behind the first champion hit. World Ender is 120/100/80 — heal amp is how you take the shell and keep walking.
audit.corrected: Collateral Damage (R) is a 100s shell that also cones behind him. Take it on World Ender's heal amp, then stay glued once Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1) is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Quickdraw (E, 16/15/14/13/12) is his only dash — Infernal Chains grounds it, so W on his step-up ends the kite. Smoke Screen (W, 26/24/22/20/18) cuts sight, not your ground-targeted Q.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Graves. Infernal Chains (W) grounds and drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — hold it for Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1), his only dash, and the kite is over. Smoke Screen (W, 26s) cuts your sight but not your ground-targeted Q, so keep slamming. Save World Ender for the committed fight, never a single Q.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Graves. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. He's mobile, so hold W until after he commits his dash, then chain him so he can't reset or kite your Q. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive his ultimate — never burn it for a single Q.
